warnings.summary: no %PDF-x.y header in the first 1,024 bytes; parsing went ahead
warnings.hint: nothing to do if the document reads correctly; open in strict mode to refuse such files

warnings.summary: the stored cross-reference data was unusable and was rebuilt by scanning
warnings.hint: check the result; save with a full rewrite, since an incremental update refuses a repaired base

warnings.summary: a hybrid file's /XRefStm could not be read and was ignored
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the classic xref table is used instead

warnings.summary: a stream's /Length was wrong, so its end was found by scanning for endstream
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a full rewrite writes the correct length

warnings.summary: a reference's generation did not match its xref entry, so it resolved to null
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the reference is treated as missing

warnings.summary: a page-tree node was missing, malformed or too deep, and was skipped
warnings.hint: check the page count: pages under the skipped node are missing

warnings.summary: the page tree's /Count differs from the number of pages walked
warnings.hint: nothing to do; lamina uses the walked page count

warnings.summary: Flate data was truncated or had a bad checksum; the partial output was kept
warnings.hint: check the affected content: the end of the stream may be missing

warnings.summary: an object stream's index was stale and the object was found by searching
warnings.hint: nothing to do; a full rewrite writes a correct index

warnings.summary: an xref entry above max_object_number was dropped
warnings.hint: raise max_object_number in Limits only if you trust the input

warnings.summary: AES-encrypted data had a bad length or padding and was kept as stored
warnings.hint: treat the affected strings and streams as suspect: they may have been tampered with

warnings.summary: an R5/R6 document's /Perms does not match its /P and /EncryptMetadata
warnings.hint: treat the document's permissions as untrusted

warnings.summary: more than max_warnings warnings were raised and the rest were dropped
warnings.hint: raise max_warnings in Limits if you need the full list

warnings.summary: a page boundary box is not four numbers and reads as absent
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the page uses the next box in the fallback chain

warnings.summary: a page's /Rotate is not a multiple of 90 and reads as 0
warnings.hint: set the page rotation explicitly if 0 is wrong

warnings.summary: a name- or number-tree node was malformed, repeated or too deep, and was skipped
warnings.hint: check the tree's entries: those under the skipped node are missing

warnings.summary: an outline item was reached twice; that branch of the walk stopped
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the outline is read without the loop

warnings.summary: an outline item was missing, not a dictionary or too deep, and was skipped with its subtree
warnings.hint: check the outline: the skipped item and its children are missing

warnings.summary: an Info date is not a valid PDF date; the raw string is kept
warnings.hint: read the raw value from the Info view if you need it

warnings.summary: a /PageLabels entry is malformed; the malformed part is dropped
warnings.hint: nothing to do; affected pages fall back to decimal labels

warnings.summary: an entry a view reads is unreadable or of the wrong type and reads as absent
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the view uses the entry's default

warnings.summary: an operator the spec does not define was skipped outside a BX/EX section
warnings.hint: nothing to do; check the page's rendering if the operator mattered

warnings.summary: an operator had too few operands or operands of the wrong type, or extra ones
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the operator was skipped or used its last operands

warnings.summary: a Q without a matching q was ignored, or saved graphics states were left open
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the graphics state was restored as the spec intends

warnings.summary: a text object was opened twice, closed outside one, or left open
warnings.hint: nothing to do; text operators outside a text object were handled tolerantly

warnings.summary: an EMC without a matching BMC or BDC was ignored, or marked content was left open
warnings.hint: check tagged-content results: marked-content sequences were closed for you

warnings.summary: content-stream bytes that are not a token were skipped
warnings.hint: check the page's content: the bytes around the reported offset were skipped

warnings.summary: an operator named a resource that is missing, of the wrong type or unreadable
warnings.hint: check the page's resources: the operator ran without the resource or was skipped

warnings.summary: no EI ends an inline image; the rest of the content was skipped
warnings.hint: check the page's content: everything after the inline image is missing

warnings.summary: a Form XObject draws itself, directly or through other forms
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the inner Do was skipped

warnings.summary: a content stream ended with a path no painting operator ended
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the unpainted path was dropped as the spec intends

warnings.summary: a font dictionary has a missing or malformed entry, so its text was decoded with defaults
warnings.hint: nothing to do; extracted text or positions for that font may be off

warnings.summary: a font's CMap or ToUnicode CMap is malformed or names a predefined CMap lamina has no table for
warnings.hint: nothing to do; the bad entries were skipped and the rest of the CMap is used

warnings.summary: a font shows glyphs that nothing maps to text
warnings.hint: nothing to do; those glyphs extract as U+FFFD (the file needs a ToUnicode CMap)

errors.summary: the input does not look like a PDF at all
errors.hint: check that the bytes passed to open are a PDF file

errors.summary: no document catalog (/Root) was found, even after repair
errors.hint: use another copy of the file: this one has no usable catalog

errors.summary: a reference chain or the page tree loops back on itself
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a hard Limits value was exceeded
errors.hint: the input exceeds a safety limit; raise {limit} in Limits only if you trust the input

errors.summary: strict mode refused something the tolerant reader would have repaired
errors.hint: open without strict mode to read the file with repairs, or fix the file

errors.summary: the ByteSource has not fetched the byte ranges the call needs yet
errors.hint: fetch the listed ranges into the source and retry the call
retry the call, or check the source; the document stays usable

errors.summary: an object had a different type than the structure requires
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: an object stream, xref section or filter parameter was malformed
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a writer object number was reserved but never given a value
errors.hint: this is a lamina bug: report it with the steps that led to it

errors.summary: an incremental update was requested for a document whose xref needed repair
errors.hint: save with a full rewrite instead of an incremental update

errors.summary: a save of an encrypted document was requested
errors.hint: saving encrypted documents is not supported yet; use another tool to decrypt or re-encrypt

errors.summary: the document is encrypted with a user password and none was given
errors.hint: pass the document's password in OpenOptions

errors.summary: the given password is neither the user nor the owner password
errors.hint: ask for the password again and retry with the correct one

errors.summary: the document uses a security handler lamina cannot decrypt
errors.hint: use a tool that supports this encryption to decrypt the file first

errors.summary: the input ended before a complete token or object was read
errors.hint: use a complete copy of the file: this one looks truncated

errors.summary: a token or structure did not match the PDF grammar
errors.hint: use another copy of the file, or repair it with another tool

errors.summary: a stream uses a filter lamina does not implement
errors.hint: use a tool that supports the filter to read this stream
use another copy of the file: this stream's data is damaged

opErrors.summary: a transaction was started, or undo or redo called, while one is open
opErrors.hint: commit or roll back the open transaction first, or use a savepoint inside it

opErrors.summary: apply, commit or rollback was called without an open transaction
opErrors.hint: call begin first, or use transact

opErrors.summary: an op names a page the document does not have
opErrors.hint: use a PageId from this document's pages()

opErrors.summary: the page is a direct dictionary, which ops cannot edit yet
opErrors.hint: rewrite the file so that every page is an indirect object, or wait for page-structure ops

opErrors.summary: an op log has a schema version this reader does not know
opErrors.hint: upgrade lamina to a version that reads this op log version

opErrors.summary: an op log does not parse: an unknown op or field, a bad value, or not JSON
opErrors.hint: validate the op log against the op schema; the samples in fixtures/ops show the format

opErrors.summary: the document was saved to a sink lamina cannot read back and waits for rebase
opErrors.hint: call rebase with the saved bytes before applying ops or saving again

opErrors.summary: rebase was called without a save waiting for it
opErrors.hint: call rebase only after a save that returned SavedNotRebased

saveErrors.summary: the sink failed to take the bytes or could not give them back
saveErrors.hint: check the destination and retry the save; the document is unchanged

saveErrors.summary: the output was written, but rebasing the document onto it failed
saveErrors.hint: retry rebase with the saved output carried by the error

saveErrors.summary: the sink already held bytes before the save started
saveErrors.hint: pass an empty sink: output offsets count from the sink's first byte

saveErrors.summary: the save would break one or more signatures
saveErrors.hint: save with SaveMode::Auto, or ask the user and retry with SaveOptions::with_invalidate_signatures

saveErrors.summary: an incremental save was requested but only a full rewrite is safe

textErrors.summary: font bytes could not be read as a font
textErrors.hint: pass the complete bytes of a .ttf, .otf, .ttc or .otc file

textErrors.summary: a font collection member past the end of the collection was asked for
an instance was asked for on a variation axis the font does not have
textErrors.hint: check the font's axes before choosing coordinates, or use a variable font

textErrors.summary: the font's OS/2 fsType forbids embedding
textErrors.hint: use another font, or register it with EmbedPolicy::Override if your licence allows embedding

textErrors.summary: the font has no glyph for a character of the text
textErrors.hint: use a font that covers the character, or split the text across fonts

textErrors.summary: a glyph ID at or past the font's glyph count was used
textErrors.hint: pass glyph IDs from the font you registered

textErrors.summary: a FontKey was used with a registry that did not hand it out
textErrors.hint: use the key returned by this registry's add
try another version or format of the font, and report the font if it is a common one

textErrors.summary: a variation axis value was NaN or infinite
textErrors.hint: pass finite axis values; values outside the axis range are clamped

textErrors.summary: finish_fonts was given a document the registry did not reserve its fonts in
textErrors.hint: use one FontRegistry per document and finish it with that document

textErrors.summary: an OpenType feature setting did not parse
textErrors.hint: write it as liga=0, -liga, smcp or aalt=2 (HarfBuzz syntax without ranges)

textErrors.summary: a byte range was out of bounds or not on character boundaries of the text
textErrors.hint: take ranges from lamina's results (line_breaks, itemize, break_lines) and pass the same text

textErrors.summary: a layout option that is not implemented yet was asked for
textErrors.hint: leave the option at its default; justification comes with a later release

textErrors.summary: a shaped run was given with a font key for a different font than it was shaped with
textErrors.hint: pass the key of the font the run was shaped with (the font index of each line run maps to your keys)

textErrors.summary: a standard 14 font has no free one-byte code left for another glyph
textErrors.hint: embed a font with Font::from_bytes, or split the text across two registrations of the standard font

textErrors.summary: a standard 14 font was given to shaping or layout, which need a font program
textErrors.hint: draw standard 14 fonts with FontRegistry::encode, or shape with an embedded font

textWarnings.summary: one glyph was used for two different texts; ToUnicode keeps the first
textWarnings.hint: mark the second occurrence with /ActualText so extraction gets its text

textWarnings.summary: a font that forbids subsetting was rebuilt with every glyph kept
textWarnings.hint: check that the font's licence allows this, or use a static TrueType or CFF version

buildErrors.summary: image bytes are not a readable image of the format they were given as
buildErrors.hint: pass the complete bytes of a JPEG or PNG file to Image::jpeg or Image::png

buildErrors.summary: the image uses a feature that PDF or lamina does not support
buildErrors.hint: convert it to a baseline or progressive 8-bit JPEG, or to PNG

buildErrors.summary: the image needs more memory than the builder allows (a decoded PNG over 256 MiB, or raw dimensions whose size overflows)
buildErrors.hint: scale the image down before adding it

buildErrors.summary: raw image samples are not width x height x channels bytes long
buildErrors.hint: pass exactly 4 bytes (RGBA) per pixel, row by row

buildErrors.summary: the bytes are not a usable ICC profile
buildErrors.hint: pass a complete ICC profile with a Gray, RGB or CMYK data colour space

buildErrors.summary: a colour has the wrong number of components for its colour space
buildErrors.hint: give one component per channel of the colour space (/N of the ICC profile)

buildErrors.summary: a colour string is not of the form #rgb or #rrggbb
buildErrors.hint: write the colour as # followed by 3 or 6 hexadecimal digits

buildErrors.summary: a page size, box, /UserUnit, drawing value (coordinate, matrix, line width, dash, miter limit) or image size is not usable
buildErrors.hint: use finite coordinates, positive page sizes and /UserUnit, non-negative line widths and dashes, a miter limit of at least 1, and images of at least one pixel

buildErrors.summary: a text box's lines don't all fit its height and its options asked for an error
buildErrors.hint: make the box taller or the text shorter, or use Overflow::Clip and read TextLayout::overflow

buildErrors.summary: a link, outline item or destination names a page index the document doesn't have
buildErrors.hint: use a 0-based index below the document's page count

buildErrors.summary: a link or outline item names a destination that was never defined
buildErrors.hint: define it with Builder::destination before the build finishes, or link to a page

buildErrors.summary: page label ranges that don't start at page 0, don't increase, start past the last page or number from 0
buildErrors.hint: give ranges sorted by first page, the first at page 0, numbered from 1

facadeErrors.summary: a CancelToken stopped the work; the job is finished and returned no partial result
facadeErrors.hint: nothing to do: this is the outcome the caller asked for; start a new job to try again

facadeErrors.summary: a job was stepped after it had finished, failed or been cancelled
facadeErrors.hint: stop stepping a job once a step returned its result or an error; create a new job

facadeErrors.summary: the document a job was created for changed (an edit, undo, redo, save or rebase) or a different document was passed to step
facadeErrors.hint: pass the document the job was created from, and don't change it while the job runs; create a new job

bindingErrors.summary: a builder or one of its pages was used after it finished
bindingErrors.hint: create a new builder or page: a finished one takes no more drawing, pages, fonts or settings

bindingErrors.summary: a value passed to a binding does not have the shape its type declares
bindingErrors.hint: pass the value the type declarations describe; the data field says what was wrong

bindingErrors.summary: a sparse source was given more bytes than its byte budget allows
bindingErrors.hint: raise the source's budget, or open the file with fewer bytes fetched (smaller blocks, no readahead)

bindingErrors.summary: an options record passed to a binding has a key lamina does not know
bindingErrors.hint: remove the key or correct its spelling; didYouMean lists the closest known names

packageErrors.summary: init() or loadText() named a different source for a module that is already loaded or loading
packageErrors.hint: call init and loadText with a source once, before the first load; later calls need no source

packageErrors.summary: page.text() was called on a document opened in the base module, which has no text extraction
packageErrors.hint: load the extract module (init with the extract option, or loadExtract) or the text module before opening the document

packageErrors.summary: a range source could not fetch input bytes: a network error, an HTTP status other than 200 and 206, a 206 whose Content-Range or length doesn't match the request, or a read that returned the wrong number of bytes
packageErrors.hint: check that the URL is reachable and that the server sends the CORS headers range requests need (Content-Range must be exposed); data.reason and data.status say what failed

packageErrors.summary: an @lamina/pdf function was called before init() finished loading the WebAssembly module
packageErrors.hint: await init() once before calling anything else in @lamina/pdf

packageErrors.summary: a remote file changed while it was being read: its ETag or length differs from the first response
packageErrors.hint: open the file again; the document already read parts of the old version and can't mix in the new one

packageErrors.summary: a font or text call was made on a builder of the base module, which has no fonts or text
packageErrors.hint: load the text module with init and the text option, or with loadText, before creating the builder that draws text

packageErrors.summary: a document, builder or other handle was used after free(), or after the using block that held it ended
packageErrors.hint: free a handle only after its last use; to keep working, open the document again or create a new builder
